title: Terms of Service | Praevius
text:
Last Updated: 27 September 2026


Praevius (praevius.app and app.praevius.app) is operated by Robert Kowalski, trading as BIM Takeoff (“we”, “us”, “our”). By accessing or using Praevius, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you disagree with any part of these terms, you may not access the service.



Praevius is a cloud-based construction programme and cost platform. It runs in a web browser. The service includes:

Programme module: create and edit construction programmes (Gantt chart, critical path, calendars, baselines and progress); import Microsoft Project (.mpp, .xml), Asta Powerproject (.pp) and Primavera P6 (.xer) files; and export to Microsoft Project XML, Primavera XER, PDF and Excel. Each import and export shows a report of the items that could not be carried across.
AI assistant: an assistant that reads and edits your programmes and project data from typed or spoken instructions, and answers questions about them. Ordinary edits apply at once and can be undone. Larger or destructive changes are proposed first and run only when you confirm them.
Voice input: you can speak instructions to the AI assistant instead of typing them. In the web app, speech is converted to text by your browser’s speech recognition service. In the mobile app, speech is converted to text on your device. The mobile app can also read the assistant’s answers aloud.
Agent access (MCP): you can connect your own AI agent to Praevius over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with OAuth sign-in. Read access is available on every plan. Write actions need the Professional or Scale plan and your confirmation.
Cost control module: budget tracking, variance analysis, change orders, progress claims and AI-generated reports, on the Essential plan and above. Schedule of Values is available on the Scale plan only.
Integrations with third-party services that you choose to connect.
Data storage and export, subject to the limits of your plan.

The features, limits and quotas of each plan are shown on our Pricing page.




You must be 18 years or older to use this service
You must provide accurate and complete information
You are responsible for maintaining account security
One person or legal entity per account
You may not use the service for illegal purposes





Prices are in USD unless otherwise stated
Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually
Payment is due at the start of each billing period
The Essential and Professional plans include a 30-day free trial. No card is needed. If you do not subscribe by the end of the trial, your organisation moves to the Free plan limits. Your data is not deleted.
To change a paid plan, write to support@praevius.app
If you ask within 30 days of your first payment, we refund that payment in full
We reserve the right to change pricing with 30 days notice





You retain ownership of all data you input into Praevius
You grant us license to process your data to provide the service
We may use anonymised, aggregated data for analytics
You can export your programmes at any time, within the export limits of your plan. For a full copy of your data, contact support@praevius.app
Upon account termination, your data will be deleted per our Privacy Policy




You agree not to:

Violate any laws or regulations
Upload malicious code or attempt to breach security
Resell or redistribute the service without permission
Use automated systems, scrapers or bots to access the service, except through the Praevius MCP server or other interfaces we provide, and within the limits of your plan
Interfere with other users’ access to the service





Praevius and its content are protected by copyright and trademark
You may not copy, modify, or distribute our software
Feedback you provide may be used to improve the service





We provide integrations with third-party services (for example Xero, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, Google Drive, SharePoint and Procore)
These integrations are subject to their own terms of service
We are not responsible for third-party service availability or changes




THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED “AS IS” WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND. WE DO NOT GUARANTEE:

Uninterrupted or error-free service
The accuracy of AI-generated content, AI assistant actions, voice transcriptions, and programme imports and exports
Compatibility with all systems
That the service will meet all your requirements

You are responsible for checking programmes and reports before you rely on them or submit them.



TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, PRAEVIUS SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR:

Indirect, incidental, or consequential damages
Loss of profits, data, or business opportunities
Damages exceeding the amount paid in the preceding 12 months




You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Praevius from any claims arising from your use of the service or violation of these terms.



We may modify these terms at any time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. Material changes will be communicated via email.




You may cancel your subscription at any time
We may terminate accounts for violation of these terms
Upon termination, your access will end and data will be deleted per our retention policy




These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Disputes shall be resolved in the courts of England and Wales.



For questions about these terms:
Email: info@praevius.app
Operator: Robert Kowalski, trading as BIM Takeoff

Praevius is part of the BIM Takeoff ecosystem.

Frequently Asked




Is the programme module included in every plan?


Yes. Every plan includes the programme module with Gantt, critical path, baselines, the programme assistant with voice input, import from MS Project, Asta or Primavera, and export for MS Project or Primavera. The plan sets how many programmes, baselines, imports and assistant requests you get: Free includes 1 programme of up to 150 tasks, Essential 10 programmes, and Professional and Scale unlimited programmes, each of up to 2,000 tasks.




Is there a free plan?


Yes. The Free plan gives you 3 projects, 1 team member and the programme module with 1 programme of up to 150 tasks. Upgrade any time as your needs grow.




How does the free trial work?


Essential and Professional start with a 30-day free trial, and no credit card is needed. Scale starts through our sales team. If the trial ends without payment, your account falls back to the Free plan limits. Nothing is deleted.




Are there any per-user fees?


No. Each plan includes a set number of team members, and the Scale plan includes unlimited team members. No hidden per-seat charges.




How does the price compare with per-user programme licences?


Praevius charges one monthly price per company, not a licence for each user. Each plan includes a set number of team members: 1 on Free, 3 on Essential, 10 on Professional and unlimited on Scale. Adding a planner, site manager or QS to the team costs nothing extra until you reach the plan limit. Many scheduling tools are licensed per user, so compare the total cost for your whole team with the plan that fits.




Can I change plans later?


Yes. To change a paid plan, write to support@praevius.app. If you cancel, your plan stays active until the end of the billing period, and you can reactivate it before that date.




Is annual billing available?


Yes. Annual billing gives you 2 months free: Essential $990 per year, Professional $2,290 per year and Scale $4,490 per year, in USD.




What integrations are included?


Essential includes Google Drive Sync, SharePoint Document Sync and one accounting integration: Xero Invoicing, QuickBooks Online or Sage Intacct. Professional and Scale include all three accounting integrations. Scale adds Procore ↔︎ SharePoint Sync and Schedule of Values.




What is Agent Access?


Agent Access connects your own AI agent to the Praevius MCP server. Agent access is available over MCP with OAuth sign-in; read on every plan, write actions need Professional or Scale and your confirmation.




What’s included in support?


Paid plans include live support from our team by Microsoft Teams, phone or WhatsApp, including help with your first programme import. Every plan includes email support at support@praevius.app.









Larger Team? Talk to Us


Scale is for mid-market contractors and multi-office teams, with unlimited projects, team members and programmes, Procore ↔︎ SharePoint Sync and Schedule of Values. Talk to us to start on Scale, plan your onboarding and import your existing MS Project, Asta or Primavera programmes.

30-Day Money Back Guarantee


If Praevius isn’t right for your team, ask within 30 days of your first payment and we refund that payment in full. See our terms of service.

title: Gantt, Critical Path and Voice Programme Features | Praevius
text:
Construction Programme Features: Gantt, Critical Path and Voice

Talk to your programme. Import it from MS Project, Asta or Primavera, update it by voice or keyboard in the browser, and export it for MS Project or Primavera.

Get Started Free  Start Free Trial






Construction Programme


Critical path, Gantt, baselines and progress in the browser, with nothing to install. Included in every plan—the plan sets how many programmes, baselines and imports you get.




 Critical Path Scheduling


Dates are calculated by the critical path method on the programme calendar, with working days and holidays. See straight away which tasks drive your finish date.



Critical tasks marked on the Gantt


Total float and free float columns


Finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish and start-to-finish links with lags


Deadlines that warn when they are missed





 Gantt and Keyboard Grid


Build and change the programme with the mouse or the keyboard. The task grid works like MS Project.



Drag bars on the Gantt to move, stretch and link tasks


Type links as 3, 5SS+2d and durations as 2w or 2ed


Edit several tasks in one step


Undo and redo





 Structure, Constraints and Calendars


Model the programme the way you plan it, from the WBS down to individual milestones.



8 constraint types: as soon as possible, as late as possible, start or finish no earlier or no later than, must start or finish on


Deadlines, milestones and hammock tasks


WBS structure with indent and outdent


Project calendar with holidays and site shutdowns





 Baselines and Progress


Know where you are against the programme you agreed, and show it clearly at the next progress meeting.



Save baselines and compare with a baseline or a saved version


Baseline bars and finish variance on the Gantt


Progress by status date, percent complete and actual dates


Progress line that shows tasks behind or ahead





 Validate


Check programme quality before you issue it, so logic problems do not reach the client.



Open ends


Negative float


Constraints that fight the logic





 Built for the Team


Keep every programme for a job in one place and see who changed what.



Several programmes per project, with one marked current


Multi-user, with full change history


Conflict protection when two people edit the same programme


Custom fields and activity codes





Limits, stated plainly: the programme has no resource or cost loading. Each programme holds up to 2,000 tasks (150 on the Free plan). There is no native .mpp or .pp export. See programme limits by plan.







Import and Export: MS Project, Asta, Primavera


Start from the programme you already have. Every import and every export comes with a report of what could not be carried, so nothing goes missing without you knowing.




 Import


Bring in MS Project, Asta Powerproject and Primavera files. Each import arrives as a new draft and never overwrites an existing programme.



MS Project .mpp and MS Project .xml


Asta Powerproject .pp and Primavera .xer


Up to 20 MB, 2,000 tasks and 3,000 links per file


Import report before you confirm: task and link counts, how many dates move, what could not be carried





 Export


Export the programme for MS Project or Primavera, or as a PDF or spreadsheet for the meeting.



MS Project XML and Primavera XER


PDF (A3) and Excel


Export report lists what the format could not carry (XML: hammocks, activity codes as text; XER: elapsed durations and lags)


No native .mpp or .pp export. Asta Powerproject can import the MS Project XML (it may convert the calendars)





 What an Import Keeps



WBS, milestones, notes and hammocks


Finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish and start-to-finish links with lags


8 constraint types and deadlines


Project calendar and holidays


Progress: percent complete, actual dates and status date


Activity codes and custom fields





 What an Import Does Not Keep


These items are listed in the import report.



Task calendars and split tasks


Percentage lags


Resources and costs


P6 secondary constraints


Links to tasks outside the file


Links on summary tasks (moved or dropped)


Baselines stored in the file





How to import an MS Project, Asta or Primavera programme




1. Upload your file


Open the programme page and upload an MS Project .mpp or .xml file, an Asta Powerproject .pp file or a Primavera .xer file. Files can be up to 20 MB, with up to 2,000 tasks and 3,000 links.




2. Check the import report


Before anything is saved, the import report shows the task and link counts, how many dates move and what could not be carried.




3. Confirm the import


Confirm, and the programme arrives as a new draft. Nothing is overwritten. Update it by voice or keyboard, then export it for MS Project or Primavera.









Voice and AI Assistant


Say what you want to change the way you would say it on site, or type it. The programme assistant makes the change, explains the result on screen, and you can undo ordinary edits. It is on every plan; the plan sets how many requests you get.




 Just Say It



“Create a programme starting next Monday: groundworks 3 weeks, then frame 8 weeks, then fit-out 6 weeks.”


“Push frame out a week.”


“Piling can’t start before 3 March.”


“What’s driving the finish?”


“Shut the site for Christmas.”


“Baseline this as the contract programme.”


“Piling started on 3 March and is 60% done.”





 How Voice Works



Click the microphone in the assistant panel and speak


Your words appear as a live transcript you can edit


After a short pause, a visible countdown runs and the request is sent


Correct yourself as you speak: “ten days, no, twelve”


Replies appear on screen


Works in Chrome, Edge and Safari with an internet connection


English and Polish


Typing always works too





 What the Assistant Does


18 programme tools, from building a programme to exporting it.



Builds a programme from a spoken or typed description, asks for missing durations and lists every assumption


Edits many tasks in one request (up to 200 changes)


Explains the critical path and driving predecessors, and lists tasks by float


Sets links, calendars and holidays, baselines, custom fields and activity codes


Compares with a baseline or saved version, validates, imports and exports XML or XER





 You Stay in Control



Ordinary edits apply at once, and you can undo the last 25 steps


Larger or destructive changes are proposed first and run only when you confirm: deleting more than 10 tasks, imports, restores, deleting a programme or field, and changing the current programme


Confirm by voice with “yes” or “go ahead”; cancel with “no” or “cancel”










Praevius and MS Project, Asta, Primavera


Praevius works alongside the tools your main contractor uses. Here is where it differs, and where your current tool is still the right choice.




 Where It Runs


Praevius: in the browser, with nothing to install.


Desktop scheduling tools: usually installed on each planner’s computer.




 Files In and Out


Praevius: imports .mpp, MS Project .xml, .pp and .xer; exports MS Project XML, Primavera XER, PDF and Excel, with a report of what could not be carried.


Desktop scheduling tools: work in their own native file formats.




 How You Update


Praevius: by voice, by typing a request, or in the Gantt and keyboard grid.


Desktop scheduling tools: by mouse and keyboard.




 How It Is Priced


Praevius: one monthly price per company, with a set number of team members on each plan and unlimited on Scale. No per-user fees.


Desktop scheduling tools: usually a licence or subscription for each user.




 Programme Size


Praevius: up to 2,000 tasks per programme (150 on Free). Made for subcontractor, package and mid-size main-contractor programmes.


Keep your current tool for very large programmes, such as 10,000-activity P6 schedules.




 What Praevius Does Not Do


No resource or cost loading and no resource levelling. No native .mpp or .pp export. If your work needs these, keep your current tool for that part of the job.









Cost Control on the Same Platform


Cost Control is a separate module on the Essential, Professional and Scale plans. It runs on the same platform and the same projects as your programmes. Read the cost variance tracking guide.




 Budget Tracking


Budget against actual cost, with traffic-light status.



On budget within ±5%


Watch 5–10% variance


Over budget more than 10%


Live cost performance index (CPI)





 Variance Reports


Ask for the report you need and get plain-English explanations of the numbers.



Variance explanations


Trend analysis


Executive summaries



Part of AI Assistant and Agent Access, on Professional and Scale




 Change Order Management


Track every variation from inception to approval to payment.



Variation register with status tracking


Entitlement flagging


Impact assessment and pricing tools


Approval workflow





 Progress Claims


Build payment applications from your budget data instead of a spreadsheet.



Percentage complete with audit trail


Retention tracking and claim history


UK JCT, AU SOPA and US AIA formats





 Schedule of Values


Map your internal cost codes to the client’s billing structure.



UK JCT/NEC, US AIA G702/G703 and AU SOPA formats


Cost code to SOV line mapping


Payment application tracking



Scale plan only




 Integrations


Connect the accounting and document tools you already use.



Xero Invoicing, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct


Google Drive Sync, SharePoint Document Sync


Procore ↔︎ SharePoint Sync (Scale)


Essential: 1 accounting integration; Professional and Scale: all 3










Bring Your Own AI Agent



 Praevius MCP Server


Connect your own AI agent to Praevius. Agent access is available over MCP with OAuth sign-in; read on every plan, write actions need Professional or Scale and your confirmation.



Works with agents that support remote MCP servers, such as Claude, Cursor or Codex


Server URL: https://app.praevius.app/api/mcp; sign in with Google or Microsoft


Remove an agent at any time under Settings → Security → Connected agents



See Agent Access by plan








Frequently Asked Questions




Can Praevius replace MS Project, Asta or Primavera for my programme?


For subcontractor, package and mid-size main-contractor programmes, it often can. Praevius gives you critical path scheduling with total and free float, a Gantt chart, 8 constraint types, deadlines, milestones, baselines and progress against a status date, in the browser with nothing to install. You import MS Project, Asta Powerproject or Primavera files and export MS Project XML or Primavera XER, so you can still exchange programmes with the main contractor. It does not do resource or cost loading, and a programme holds up to 2,000 tasks (150 on the Free plan). If you need resource levelling, cost-loaded programmes or very large P6 programmes, keep your current tool for that work.




Can I import an .xer or .pp file without Primavera or Asta?


Yes. Upload the Primavera .xer or Asta Powerproject .pp file itself; you do not need Primavera or Asta on your computer. Praevius also imports MS Project .mpp and MS Project .xml files. Files can be up to 20 MB, with up to 2,000 tasks and 3,000 links. Before you confirm, an import report shows the task and link counts, how many dates move and what could not be carried.




Can I export back to MS Project or Primavera?


Yes. Praevius exports MS Project XML and Primavera XER, plus PDF (A3) and Excel. An export report lists anything the format could not carry: for XML, hammocks and activity codes (written as text); for XER, elapsed durations and lags. Praevius does not export native .mpp or .pp files. Asta Powerproject can import the MS Project XML, and it may convert the calendars.




What happens to my programme when I import it?


Each import arrives as a new draft programme and never overwrites an existing one. Praevius keeps the WBS, finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish and start-to-finish links with lags, 8 constraint types, deadlines, milestones, notes, the project calendar and holidays, progress, hammocks, activity codes and custom fields. It does not keep task calendars, split tasks, percentage lags, resources and costs, P6 secondary constraints, links to tasks outside the file or baselines stored in the file. Links on summary tasks are moved or dropped. The import report lists every item that was not carried.




How does voice input work?


Click the microphone in the assistant panel and speak. Your words appear as a live transcript that you can edit. After a short pause, a visible countdown runs and the request is sent. You can correct yourself as you speak, for example “ten days, no, twelve”. The assistant replies on screen. Typing always works as well as voice.




Which browsers and languages does voice support?


Voice input uses the speech recognition in Chrome, Edge and Safari, and needs an internet connection. It does not work in Firefox; you can type your request instead. Voice understands English and Polish.




Does the AI assistant change my programme without asking?


Ordinary edits apply at once and you can undo the last 25 steps. Larger or destructive changes are proposed first and run only when you confirm: deleting more than 10 tasks, imports, restores, deleting a programme or a field, and changing the current programme. You can confirm by voice with “yes” or “go ahead”, or cancel with “no” or “cancel”.




What is the Praevius MCP server?


The Praevius MCP server lets you connect your own AI agent to Praevius. Agent access is available over MCP with OAuth sign-in; read on every plan, write actions need Professional or Scale and your confirmation.




How does construction variance tracking work?


The Cost Control module compares budgeted and actual project costs. When costs move away from the budget, a traffic-light status shows it: green within ±5%, yellow at 5–10% variance and red over 10%. Cost Control is on the Essential, Professional and Scale plans.




How does construction change order management work?


Praevius tracks every variation from inception to approval to payment in a variation register with status tracking, entitlement flagging, impact assessment and pricing tools, and an approval workflow. It is part of the Cost Control module on Essential and above.




What is progress claim automation?


Progress claim automation takes the manual work out of payment applications. Praevius calculates percentage complete from your budget data, tracks retention, keeps an audit trail and exports claims in UK JCT, Australian SOPA and US AIA G702/G703 formats. It is part of the Cost Control module on Essential and above.









Talk to Your Programme


Start on the Free plan, or try Professional free for 30 days with no credit card. Request a demo or learn about our team.

 Start Free Trial Get Started Free

title: Construction Cost Variance Tracking | Real-Time Monitoring Guide | Praevius
text:
Construction Cost Variance Tracking: A Real-Time Monitoring Guide

Detect cost overruns before they escalate. Practical guide to variance tracking for construction subcontractors and QS professionals.







Construction cost variance tracking is the process of monitoring the difference between budgeted and actual project costs in real time, enabling project teams to identify overruns before they escalate. For subcontractors managing multiple projects on tight margins, effective variance tracking is the difference between profitable operations and cash flow crises.







What is Cost Variance in Construction?



Cost variance (CV) measures how project spending compares to the baseline budget at any point during construction. The formula is straightforward:


Cost Variance = Earned Value (EV) - Actual Cost (AC)


A positive CV means the project is under budget. A negative CV means over budget. But a single number lacks context — what matters is the percentage variance and whether it is trending better or worse.


The Cost Performance Index (CPI) provides a normalised view: CPI = EV / AC. A CPI of 1.0 is on budget, below 1.0 is over budget, above 1.0 is under budget. Research consistently shows that CPI rarely improves significantly after a project reaches 20% completion — making early detection critical.




 On Budget

Variance within ±5%. Project performing as planned. Continue current trajectory with routine monitoring.



 Watch

Variance 5-10%. Early warning. Investigate root causes and plan corrective action before the variance compounds.



 Over Budget

Variance exceeds 10%. Immediate attention required. Intervention needed to prevent further cost escalation.









Why Real-Time Tracking Matters




 The Month-End Shock


Most subcontractors discover cost overruns in monthly reports — weeks after the spending occurred. By then, the window for corrective action has closed. A $10,000 overrun caught in week one is manageable; the same overrun discovered at month-end has already compounded across downstream tasks.




 Change Order Revenue Leakage


Change orders represent 8-14% of total project value. Without real-time tracking, variations get missed, under-valued, or claimed late. Every day a variation goes untracked is potential revenue lost — and most subcontractors lack the systems to flag entitlements automatically.




 Cash Flow Forecasting Blind Spots


Only 12% of contractors get paid on time. Accurate variance tracking feeds directly into cash flow forecasting — you cannot predict next month’s cash position if you do not know this month’s true cost position. Late discovery of overruns cascades into incorrect progress claims and delayed payments.




 Compounding Errors


Construction cost variances compound. A 3% overrun in foundations affects every subsequent trade. Without continuous monitoring, small variances accumulate into major overruns that consume the project’s contingency before anyone notices.









How to Track Cost Variances Effectively




 Establish a Baseline Budget


Every variance is measured against a baseline. Lock your project budget at tender acceptance, including all trade packages, preliminaries, and contingency. Without a clear baseline, variance tracking becomes meaningless — you are comparing actuals to a moving target.




 Connect Your Accounting Data


Manual data entry introduces errors and delays. Connect your accounting platform (Xero, QuickBooks, or Sage) so that actual costs flow into your tracking system automatically. Praevius syncs with major accounting platforms to eliminate the gap between spending and reporting.




 Define Variance Thresholds


Set thresholds that trigger alerts — the traffic light system (±5% green, 5-10% yellow, >10% red) is an industry standard. Different project types may warrant different thresholds: a high-margin fitout can absorb more variance than a competitive tender won at 2% margin.




 Automate Variance Alerts


Do not rely on someone remembering to check the numbers. Automated alerts ensure that threshold breaches are flagged the moment they occur — not at the next project meeting. Real-time CPI monitoring catches trends before they become crises.




 Generate Variance Reports with Context


Numbers without context do not drive decisions. Effective variance reports explain the why behind the numbers — which cost codes are driving the overrun, whether the variance is a one-off or a trend, and what corrective actions are available. Praevius uses AI to generate these explanations automatically in plain English, turning raw data into actionable intelligence.









Common Cost Variance Indicators




 Cost Performance Index (CPI)


CPI = Earned Value / Actual Cost


The most reliable indicator of final project cost. A CPI of 0.90 means you are getting 90 cents of planned work for every dollar spent — a 10% overrun. CPI below 1.0 at 20% project completion rarely recovers without significant intervention.




 Schedule Performance Index (SPI)


SPI = Earned Value / Planned Value


Measures schedule efficiency. SPI below 1.0 means behind schedule. Schedule delays often cause cost overruns through extended prelims, acceleration costs, and liquidated damages. Tracking SPI alongside CPI gives the full picture.




 Estimate at Completion (EAC)


EAC = Budget at Completion / CPI


Projects the final cost based on current performance. If your $1M project has a CPI of 0.85, EAC projects a final cost of $1.18M — an $180K overrun. This is the number that drives management decisions and client conversations.




 Variance at Completion (VAC)


VAC = Budget at Completion - EAC


The expected budget overrun or underrun at project completion. A negative VAC means the project will exceed its budget if current trends continue. This metric is essential for contingency management and early stakeholder communication.









Frequently Asked Questions




What is an acceptable cost variance in construction?


A cost variance within ±5% of the baseline budget is generally considered acceptable and indicates the project is performing as planned. Variances between 5-10% are early warnings that require investigation. Variances exceeding 10% require immediate corrective action. These thresholds can be adjusted based on project size, complexity, and contractual requirements.




How often should you check cost variance on a construction project?


Cost variance should be monitored continuously with real-time data where possible. At minimum, review cost variance weekly during active construction phases and at every progress claim milestone. Monthly reviews are insufficient for catching overruns early — by the time a month-end report reveals a problem, the opportunity to correct course has often passed.




What causes cost variance in construction projects?


Common causes include: untracked change orders and variations (accounting for 8-14% of project value), scope creep without corresponding budget adjustments, material price escalation, labour productivity differences from estimates, rework due to quality issues, weather delays, and subcontractor claims. Many of these can be detected early through real-time variance tracking before they compound.




What is Cost Performance Index (CPI) in construction?


Cost Performance Index (CPI) is the ratio of earned value to actual cost: CPI = EV / AC. A CPI of 1.0 means the project is on budget. A CPI below 1.0 means the project is over budget (for example, CPI of 0.85 means you are getting 85 cents of work for every dollar spent). CPI above 1.0 means under budget. CPI is considered the most reliable early indicator of final project cost in Earned Value Management.




How do you calculate cost variance in construction?


Cost Variance (CV) = Earned Value (EV) minus Actual Cost (AC). A positive CV means under budget; a negative CV means over budget. For percentage: CV% = (CV / EV) × 100. For example, if a task with a $100,000 budget is complete but actually cost $112,000, the CV is -$12,000 or -12%, indicating a significant overrun requiring immediate attention.

Where they do, the transfer is protected by an adequacy decision (including the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and its UK extension, where the provider is certified) or by Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission, with the UK International Data Transfer Addendum where UK law applies.




Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher.

EU: your national data protection authority

text:

title: Privacy Policy | Praevius
text:
We keep your account, programme and project data while your account is active.
When a trial ends without payment, the organisation moves to the Free plan limits. Your data is not deleted.
When you ask us to delete your account or your organisation, we delete that data from the live service. We act on the request within one month, as data protection law requires.
Copies in backups are removed when those backups expire.
We keep billing records for as long as tax and accounting law requires.
Some short-lived service records, such as programme snapshots, assistant proposals and usage counters, are removed automatically when they are no longer needed.

title: Privacy Policy | Praevius
text:
Under the UK GDPR, the EU GDPR and the UK Data Protection Act 2018, you have the right to:

Access your personal data
Rectify inaccurate data
Erase your data (“right to be forgotten”)
Restrict processing
Data portability
Object to processing
Withdraw consent at any time, where we rely on consent

To exercise these rights, contact us at info@praevius.app. We answer within one month.
You also have the right to complain to a data protection authority:

UK: Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO), ico.org.uk
Poland: Urząd Ochrony Danych Osobowych (UODO), uodo.gov.pl
EU: your national data protection authority
Australia: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC), oaic.gov.au
